dispositions.detail: Contemporaneous v2 provenance cannot be reconstructed. Original artifacts unchanged.
Both verification gates still fail with 40 SGV301 findings, 34 stale waivers and SGV901–903 proof gaps. No waiver was refreshed.
No production persistent-container integration was added. Recreation tests remain evaluation-adapter evidence.
No independent VM was available or introduced. Same-host capability evidence remains labeled as such.
Notebook server boundary remains incomplete; C remains unsupported.

Recursive serialization is repaired consistently across A/B/C in new manifest v10. Original failures remain; new utility cohort is separately evaluated. New one-repetition cohort retains 4/10 A, 7/10 B and 5/10 C failures; no overall utility improvement is claimed.

Profiler globals isolated, timeout rows retained, Python venv path preserved and CPU affinity aligned with workflow runs. One new full C workflow succeeds with policy/audit spans and expected result; coverage is one workload, not the whole task distribution.
OpenShell runtime integration remains absent. No native canary comparison was fabricated.
SQLite still requires the trusted private namespace assumption. No general runtime alias discovery guarantee added.
Landlock content policies still do not provide metadata secrecy or Docker-equivalent process ceilings.
Original pilots and cohorts untouched. New failed profile attempts and serialization development cohorts retained separately.
New application rows include model/source/policy identity, timestamps, timing scope and explicit missing policy/audit phases. No retrospective labor estimates or universal schema claim.
All new evidence is from the same shared host. No idle-host or comparative performance claim.
No separate unbrokered native filesystem matrix added. Zero-attempt injections remain no evidence.
